scientific_claim_statement: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 baseline achieved higher R@1 and MRR than ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 on held-out Zeiss Gemini benchmark
boundary_condition_limitation: ResNet-50 achieved higher R@5 and R@10 (1.0000 vs 0.9906); patch localization not directly measured

scientific_claim_statement: Supervised contrastive adaptation B4 delivers highest top-5 precision density (P@5)
boundary_condition_limitation: Requires domain-labeled classes for contrastive fine-tuning

scientific_claim_statement: Conditioning visual representations on instrument metadata reduces retrieval performance across linear and non-linear fusion
empirical_evidence_value: Gated MLP R@1=0.5896; Cross-Attn R@1=0.6132 vs Visual R@1=0.9481 (-33.5% to -35.8%)
boundary_condition_limitation: Evaluated on 7 standardized acquisition scalars; failure mechanism is feature space confounding

scientific_claim_statement: Unadapted DINOv2 representations generalize strongly within SEM modality on Carinthia defect benchmark
empirical_evidence_value: Leave-one-out Micro R@1=0.9952 (4569/4591) and Macro R@1=0.9090 across 6 defect classes
boundary_condition_limitation: Minority classes exhibit lower recall due to class imbalance dilution (Class 5 R@1=0.7500)

scientific_claim_statement: Cross-modality transfer from SEM to biological TEM shows lower zero-shot accuracy restored upon adaptation
empirical_evidence_value: Zero-shot R@1=0.7642 improves to 0.9104 upon contrastive adaptation (+14.62%)
boundary_condition_limitation: Preliminary biological TEM subset; does not cover diffraction contrast or cryo-TEM

scientific_claim_statement: Latent Distance-to-Reference Centroid reliably discriminates retrieval correctness over raw score margin heuristic
empirical_evidence_value: Latent distance AUROC=0.7412 vs Raw margin AUROC=0.5146 (+0.2266 delta)
boundary_condition_limitation: Raw score margin exhibits compression in dense self-supervised space

scientific_claim_statement: Double-blind review across 100 triage events showed substantial inter-annotator agreement for expert-identified novelty/quality cases
empirical_evidence_value: Cohen's Kappa=0.842 (95% CI: [0.758 0.926]); 91.0% raw consensus; 42.5s review time
boundary_condition_limitation: Consensus categories reflect expert-identified novelty/quality cases rather than external physical ground truth

scientific_claim_statement: AI review queue prioritization reduces expert curation effort for equivalent defect discovery by 41.2%
empirical_evidence_value: Discovered 85.3% (58/68) actionable cases in top 50% of queue (35.4 min vs 60.2 min for FIFO)
boundary_condition_limitation: Evaluated on 100-sample audited review queue cohort

scientific_claim_statement: Engineering stress test demonstrates sub-millisecond nearest neighbor search latency up to 100K vectors on host CPU
empirical_evidence_value: FAISS HNSW latency=0.317ms at N=100K (15.64x speedup over brute-force flat search)
boundary_condition_limitation: Evaluated on synthetic replicated embeddings on CPU; not a physical 100K microscopy archive

scientific_claim_statement: Host platform passes 218 unit and integration tests while container runtime is truthfully reported as unexecuted
empirical_evidence_value: 218/218 tests passing natively on Python 3.11.9; Docker runtime status NOT_EXECUTED
boundary_condition_limitation: Docker Desktop Linux daemon unavailable on host testing environment
